$comment: Ping layer spec. Coordinates are canvas pixels, origin top-left. region = [x, y, w, h], the box a layer's visible pixels may occupy. pivot = [x, y], the point the layer rotates and scales around. Every layer is a full-canvas transparent PNG in art/layers/<id>.png. Draw order is z, low to high. Regions follow art/reference/logo-5A.svg (a 64-unit square screen, 61 units wide) drawn 878 px wide (70% of the canvas) at x, y 188..1066: logo unit u maps to 188 + (u - 1.5) * 878 / 61. Regions and pivots are a spec, not measurements; processing and checks read thresholds from here, and those are chosen limits, not measurements.

layers.about: the soft neon halo around the screen-face, everything outside the head silhouette, alpha from brightness
the screen-face with no eyes, brows or mouth, keeping the logo's prompt chevron and red cursor; pivot at the bottom centre of the screen
both eyes, closed; swapped with eyes_open for blinks
both brows, neutral (the logo has none; added in the master); expressions later come from moving this layer, not from new art

layers.covers: silence, M, B, P (lips closed); also F, V
layers.about: closed mouth, the logo's pixel smile: the default between words and the shape every M/B/P closure must hit, or speech looks mumbled

layers.covers: most consonants (T D N S Z K G L R H TH CH J) and unstressed vowels (schwa, IH, EH)
layers.about: slightly open: the most frequent speaking shape; without it the mouth snaps between closed and wide

layers.covers: open stressed vowels AA, AE, AH, AY, AW
layers.about: wide open: loud open vowels and stressed syllables, the peak of each word

layers.covers: rounded vowels and glides O, OO, OW, OY, UW, W, also SH and ER
layers.about: small ring: the one shape that is about lip rounding, not openness; 'you', 'go', 'what' read wrong without it

layers.covers: spread vowels E, I, EE, EY, IY
layers.about: wide and flat: the spread-lips opposite of mouth_round; also usable as a grin

dropped.reason: F/V is read from the upper teeth resting on the lower lip. Ping's mouth is a flat shape of neon pixel blocks with no teeth and no lips, so an F/V shape would look the same as mouth_rest or mouth_small; F and V map to mouth_rest.

processing.$comment: Chosen parameters, not measurements. Values are 0..255 channel levels unless named Px.

checks.$comment: Chosen acceptance limits, not measurements. drift = mean absolute RGB difference from the master outside the changed feature, after alignment, 0..255 scale.
